name: amazon-quick-acl
description: Amazon Quick connected to an Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base, with document-level ACLs and an optional embedded chat front end

scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run synth

overridesRationale.uuid: amazon-quicksight-embedding-sdk declares uuid ^9, which npm audit flags, but inlines its own copy into dist and never loads the package at runtime. The override only clears the audit; it does not change the bundle. Remove it once the SDK depends on uuid 11.1.1+.
